propositions: Author guides (writing-a-passing-plan.md, passing-code-review.md) are read from repo_root/docs/, making them inaccessible when rebar is installed as a library or CLI against a consuming project that lacks those files.

Guide resolution must be repo-root independent by moving canonical copies into the package under src/rebar/_guides/ and reading via importlib.resources, matching the OSS convention already used by rebar for criteria_routing.json.
AUTHOR_GUIDES should map guide name to bare filename and explain_guide should resolve via resources.files('rebar._guides'), eliminating the repo_root_path parameter.

explain_criterion must render sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, while preserving overlay project criteria resolution.
Thin pointer files must remain in docs/ to preserve existing links and avoid 404s in documentation.
All CLI (rebar explain plan|review|criterion-id), MCP, and library surfaces must work from any installation directory without a docs/ tree present.
